query.title: Business/company name or registration number
query.description: A business or company name (or partial name) or URSB registration number (ERN, e.g. 80020002358032) to search for.

queries.title: Names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
